text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp had arrived. In 
preparation for the Kikuka Sho, they first 
sat down to discuss the training regimen 
Mejiro Bright should undertake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the target race is a long-distance one, 
it makes sense to ask an Umamusume suited 
for long distances to be a coach—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With their new approach decided, the days 
of intense special training were about to 
begin.
